error[ZBX-E0716]: can't read the state volume to export it
  while  exporting the state volume pgdata
  cause  a file or directory in it could not be read
  cause  reading /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/state/pgdata/data/base failed:
         permission denied (EACCES)
  volume pgdata
  path   /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/state/pgdata/data/base
  fix    stop what changes the volume, then export again
  more   zbx explain E0716
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0716.html
